reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness tools and settings for PaddleOCR-based image/PDF text extraction and document layout parsing, with configurable external endpoints and credential-backed API access.

summaries.zh: 通过可配置的 PaddleOCR 服务提取图片和 PDF 文本，并解析文档布局、表格及结构。
summaries.en: Uses configurable PaddleOCR services to extract text from images and PDFs and parse document layouts, tables, and structure.

capabilities: Extracts text from images and PDFs through PaddleOCR endpoints
Parses document layouts, tables, Markdown, and document structure
Sends selected local file bytes or HTTPS URLs to an externally configured OCR service
Uses a configured credential reference for PaddleOCR API access
Stores raw JSON operation results in the workspace by default
